title: Ordered Ruzsa-Szemeredi Numbers at Matching Size Two
summary: Bondy and Szwarcfiter defined $\mathrm{ex}^*(n,F)$ as the largest number of edges in an $n$-vertex graph whose edge set partitions into induced copies of $F$; for $F=2K_2$ the deficiency $\binom{n}{2}-\mathrm{ex}^*(n,2K_2)$ is $Θ(n^{3/2})$. We study the ordered relaxation at fixed matching size, in which each part need only be induced in the union of itself with the parts that follow it; write $\mathrm{ORS}_n(r)$ for the largest number of parts, so that $r\,\mathrm{ORS}_n(r)$ is the ordered analogue of $\mathrm{ex}^*(n,rK_2)$.
